name: Doki Doki Yandere Club
source:
Your childhood friend, Sayori invites you to the Literature Club. However, the next day you notice something's off about the girls. They became absolutely obsessed over you! It's like your dreams came true, but it's more than you bargained for. Can you find out what happened to them? Better yet... can you survive their rabid love-craze?

Source: [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/yandere-club]DokiMods.me[/url]
